correctness.rationale: The proof is sound. For a special-line realization of K_{2,n}, remove the vertices lying on the spine xy and form the incidence graph Q between distinct x-lines and y-lines, one edge per off-spine B-vertex. Q is simple and every vertex has degree at least two: an edge line must contain a third configuration point, and that point must be another off-spine B-vertex on the same x- or y-line. Thus every component of Q has at least four edges. All B-points belonging to one component lie in a single affine plane through xy, so if c is the number of components the total affine dimension is at most c+1 and 4c<=|B*|<=n. The explicit q-page construction with four points per page realizes dimension q+1, while the remaining r vertices can be placed on the spine, giving exactly 1+floor(n/4).

originality.rationale: Dvir introduced SG-dimension in August 2026. His Observation 2.5 treats complete bipartite graphs only asymptotically, stating SG-dim(K_{m,s})=Theta(m/s) via matching lower and upper bounds; it does not give the exact K_{2,n} value. Searches for the exact formula 1+floor(n/4) and for a K_{2,n} classification found no earlier theorem. This is a direct exact determination in a newly introduced parameter.

scientific_value.rationale: An exact formula with a matching geometric construction and a sharp component-counting upper bound materially sharpens the only nearby published complete-bipartite statement, which is asymptotic. The proof also isolates a reusable incidence-graph/page decomposition mechanism rather than relying on computation.

independent_checks: Reconstructed the x-line/y-line incidence graph Q and verified simplicity, minimum degree at least 2, and the four-edges-per-component dimension bound.
Checked the four-point page construction algebraically and verified that q pages plus the spine span affine dimension q+1 while preserving every required special line.
limitations: The graph parameter was introduced only in August 2026, so indexing of very recent follow-up work may be incomplete.
No inaccessible source is represented as read.

sources.note: Zeev Dvir, The Sylvester–Gallai dimension of graphs (2026). Full PDF inspected; Observation 2.5 gives only an asymptotically matching Theta(m/s) statement for K_{m,s}.
